correctness.rationale: For all primes p and q=p^s, direct expansion verifies both Novikov identities. Coefficient recurrences uniquely construct h and g. The exact split into unit, order-one and high-order radical lines proves completeness; each idempotent is either g or lies on a unit line with nonzero square scalar. The last two coefficients of the arbitrary parameter enter the obstruction pair triangularly with slope one, proving exactly q^(p-2) parameters per pair. The standalone checker independently exhausts parameters in p=2,q=2 and 4, p=3,q=3, and all parameter pairs for p=5,q=5, with direct subalgebra/idempotent counts on 32 p=5 samples. Boundary p=2 and nonprime q=4 checked. No finite result is used as a general proof.

originality.rationale: Primary full-text comparison establishes that Zhelyabin and Zakharov (2024) formulate the differential Novikov construction and classify structure, not the all-parameter joint finite-field subalgebra/idempotent frequencies. The new theorem counts every parameter by an obstruction-pair fiber argument, which is not a rephrasing of the published structural representation. Relevant public research-record searches and broader primary bibliography yield no equivalent full joint distribution. The 1992 Osborn idempotent paper remains an explicit material-access risk rather than being claimed not to contain it.
residual_risks: The 1992 Osborn full text was inaccessible after bounded lawful-source attempts and might contain an equivalent idempotent classification or a stronger statement.
The 2025/2026 automorphism-classification paper was available at abstract level only; its unseen appendices could include related invariants.
Indexed published claims do not establish global uniqueness or reveal unpublished work; different terminology could conceal equivalent results.

value.rationale: This is a full q^p-parameter finite-field family of the classical differential Novikov construction, not an arbitrary finite sample. The complete joint idempotent/line spectrum identifies four arithmetically distinct strata, including an exact q^(p-2)-fiber phenomenon and an explicit geometric decomposition of every line subalgebra. It supplies a natural structural invariant that general Novikov structure or automorphism classification does not calculate, and reveals substantial characteristic-dependent high-valuation square-zero families.
